promises.quote: Allocation of staff to and practical supervision of Residents whilst eating and drinking to assess any issues.
promises.summary: Staff allocated for supervision during meals to assess issues.

promises.quote: Completion of the swallowing risk assessment with independent validation from another senior colleague to ensure accurate scoring and corresponding actions to mitigate risk are adhered to. This system remains in place with the Care Manager reviewing and signing off any updates.
promises.summary: Swallowing risk assessment completed with senior validation and Care Manager oversight.

promises.quote: All Residents whose assessment indicated having reached the appropriate threshold of need have been referred to the Speech and Language team (SALT) service via the GP for review- New referrals have also been actioned and follow-ups reviews have been planned by SALT- 2 existing Residents are due a review, which have been scheduled.
promises.summary: SALT referrals completed and scheduled for review.

promises.quote: The Care Manager has taken responsibility for oversight of communication between SALT and colleagues at the home to ensure optimum communication and appropriate escalation for support.
promises.summary: Care Manager oversees SALT communication and escalation.

promises.quote: Once this initial work was completed at Stoneyford, we sought advice from senior clinicians within the company for governance and oversight, which resulted in the care plans being rewritten to specify the detailed plan of care for each Resident.
promises.summary: Care plans rewritten with senior clinician oversight.

promises.quote: Additional advice was sought from the company Hospitality specialist to establish if there were any further processes or mechanisms to help support the safe and effective management of people who require a specialist diet. As a result we have introduced a new system of dining registers with quick reference guides, which were put into place and help colleagues or any agency workers to reflect the handover documentation.
promises.summary: Dining registers and quick reference guides introduced for diet management.
